BUFFALO, N.Y. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Milwaukee Brewers have been building toward this World Series moment for decades, and now New Era, the Official Cap of Major League Baseball (MLB), is proud to celebrate alongside the team and its fans with the 2026 World Series Championship Collection.
The culmination of decades of perseverance and hard work, the Brewers completed a dominant Postseason run to capture the club's first-ever World Series title. New Era designed its World Series Collection to honor the players' hard-earned achievement on the field and equip their dedicated fans with a commemorative collectible to remember the journey to get here.
"The Milwaukee Brewers entered the World Series as the team to beat after a record-breaking season. They carried that momentum every step of the way to cement their place as the best team in baseball," said Chris Koch, CEO of New Era . "The passion of Brewers' fans has been incredible, and their loyalty has endured through every high and low. New Era is proud to be part of this championship moment and celebrate both the franchise and their devoted fanbase with a collection worthy of a World Series champion."
Crafted in New Era's signature silhouettes, the Milwaukee Brewers 2026 World Series Championship Collection includes the caps worn on the field during the championship celebration, at the team's World Series parade, and a range of headwear and apparel options designed to help fans cherish their first World Series title.
